contexts.text: Even to the drying up of the waters upon the earth () = the apparent dissipation of falsities.
The earth was dried up () = that he was regenerate.
The water (of the Euphrates) was dried up ()... The water dried up = those falsities removed by the Lord.
To dry up the sea () = to blot out the good and truth of scientifics.
To dry up the sea of Babel, and to dry up its spring () = to extinguish all the truth of that Church, from primes to ultimates.
The water (of the Euphrates) was dried up = that the falsities of these interior reasonings have been removed. AE 996.
A drying up and induration of the crystalline humour.
Under Dry up, see these references. AE 730:12.
All the trees of the field are withered () = the Knowledges of good and truth which, from evils and falsities, are consummated. AE 458:7.
To make the rivers into islands, and to dry up the pools () = to annihilate all the understanding and perception of truth.
Under Dry up, see these references. AE 518:31.
To dry up the sea () = to deprive the natural man of scientific truths, and thus of natural and spiritual life.
The dissipation of the evils and falsities which are from the Hells, and protection from them, is signified by to dry up the abyss, and to dry up the rivers ().
To dry up all the depths of the river () = to dissipate all the falsities of evil, even the deeper ones.
To be dried up, etc. () = to perish and vanish.
The streams of water are dried up () = truths of doctrine dissipated through natural love.
